The SEC advises that such aspects may create conflicts of interest that may compromise the interests of public customers and result in financial harm to the customers. Cetera Wealth Services, LLC (CWS) reports material aspects of its relationships with Specified Venues which includes but is not limited to the following: 1.The routing of CWS’s order flow is managed exclusively by Pershing and National Financial Services (NFS).
